spec.rig: skinned; baked Idle, Walk, Run (quadruped_rig, as Mob_Lab_Hornback)

axes: metres; Blender Z up; origin bottom centre; front = Blender -Y; glTF +Y up; stock UE glTF Interchange maps UE = 100 * (x_b, -y_b, z_b) (UEB 48725), so the front lands on UE +Y; decided (buffffff 48769): no export rotation, face it with actor/component yaw -90 at placement (like the UE mannequin); assets whose UE attach code needs mesh +X forward get revisited one by one; L = Blender +X (the animal's own left)
bind: ARMATURE_AUTO bone-heat weights, validated per part (dominant bone within 2 hops of the part's bone), rigid per-part fallback; <=4 influences, normalised

unreal.type: skeletal mesh + 3 anim sequences (Idle, Walk, Run), root bone 'Root'
unreal.collision: capsule/physics asset in UE (no UCX on skeletal meshes)
